description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.005 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Rug pull check: one ERC-20 token, pass/warn/fail on four groups - honeypot signals (GoPlus simulation, buy/sell tax, cannot sell all), owner rights (mint, blacklist, pause, hidden owner, proxy, renounce, source verified), liquidity (USD, pairs, pair age, LP locked/burned) and holder concentration - plus an overall rugRisk. Base or Ethereum. Data: GoPlus Security public API (contract flags, taxes, honeypot simulation, holders, LP lock) + DexScreener (pairs, liquidity, volume). Every flag names its source field. Not financial advice. When to use: Use rug-check for new or unknown tokens (memecoins, snipes): honeypot, owner rights, liquidity and holder checks with pass/warn/fail.
